content:
I noticed that the entry title is the repository name (page heading, browser title, and the title field of the generated BibTeX). project.name, which CONTRIBUTING requires, doesn't seem to appear on the rendered entry at all.

A side effect is that two entries from one repository are titled identically. The homepage currently says 119 registered results across 85 source projects.

Would using project.name as the entry title, or showing it alongside the
repository, be worth considering? It's already required so it needs no schema change.

I was hoping to submit a few results from a deliberately multi-result repo, and it looks like others have tried to do the same given the duplicate names that are registered already and the discussion in this thread.
Yes, sorry, multi-result repos were outside of our original design, and hacked on later. I'm thinking about how to fix this properly now.
